property_summary: If every entry of the target list is an address with non-empty code, then c.transfer never reverts.
If transfer succeeds, it forwards exactly one transferFrom call per recipient in the arrays, in the same order, and returns true.
If transfer succeeds, it returns true and does not revert for any non-empty arrays of equal length.
If the length of the recipient array does not match the length of the value array, the transfer must revert.
If transfer is called with more value entries than recipient addresses, it must revert.
If the recipient and value arrays have different lengths, transfer must revert.
